## Description {#details}

Internal implementation details for the µTest++ framework.

The <code>detail</code> namespace encapsulates the internal mechanisms, helper structures, and implementation utilities employed by the µTest++ testing framework. These components do not form part of the public API and may be modified without prior notice.

Within this namespace, one will find assertion handling, generic getter utilities, comparator structures for logical and relational operations, mechanisms for exception checking, and base classes for deferred reporting of test results.

All definitions within <code>detail</code> are intended exclusively for internal use, ensuring a clear distinction between user-facing and internal components. This approach enhances maintainability, mitigates the risk of naming conflicts, and keeps the public API succinct.

The relevant header files are organised within the <code>include/micro-os-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.

### get() {#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class T&gt;</>}

Generic getter function template for value retrieval.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type from which the value is to be retrieved.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="t">The object or value to be accessed.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
The value obtained via the relevant getter implementation.
</SectionUser>

The <code>get</code> function template invokes the appropriate getter implementation to retrieve the value from the provided object or type. This function ensures consistent access to values for both custom and standard types within the framework.

The primary implementation attempts to invoke a <code><a href="#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</a></code> method if it exists, which is recommended for user-defined types to ensure consistent value access. If the type does not provide a <code><a href="#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</a></code> method, the fallback variadic implementation simply returns the original argument.

The <code>get</code> function template delegates to these implementations, enabling seamless support for a wide range of types in test expressions and comparators.

All definitions are intended for internal use within the framework and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.

The <code>get&#95;impl</code> function template serves as a fallback mechanism for value retrieval when the provided type does not implement a <code><a href="#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</a></code> member function. It simply returns the first argument, discarding any additional parameters.

This approach ensures that both custom types (with a <code><a href="#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</a></code> method) and standard types (without a <code><a href="#ac627271520bf2fe8a4c4774bcd9bf343">get()</a></code> method) are supported seamlessly within the framework&#39;s generic getter utilities.

All definitions are intended for internal use within the framework and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
